content.name: Liam O'Connor
content.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with nearly a decade in furniture retail, agency paid search and pet insurance in Melbourne. Owns SEO, SEM and lifecycle email for an online pet insurer and grew organic quote starts by 52% by rebuilding its breed and condition content library.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Own SEO, Google Ads and lifecycle email for a direct pet insurer, with $720,000 in annual paid media.
Planned and briefed 180 breed and health-condition articles with a vet adviser, lifting organic quote starts by 52% in 18 months.
Cut paid search cost per policy by 21% by splitting brand and generic budgets and adding postcode-level bid adjustments.
Built renewal reminder and multi-pet cross-sell journeys in Braze that raised retention at first renewal from 78% to 84%.
Work with the compliance team to make sure ads and product pages meet general advice and PDS disclosure rules.

experience.title: Paid Search Specialist
bullets: Managed Google and Microsoft Ads accounts for 12 clients in education, automotive and trades, with up to $150,000 monthly spend each.
Took a TAFE-course provider's enrolments from paid search up by 33% in one intake by rewriting ads around course start dates and fee-free places.
Built a shared negative keyword library across accounts that reduced wasted spend by an average of 11%.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated EDMs, website banners and marketplace listings for a three-showroom furniture retailer.
Grew the email database from 18,000 to 45,000 with an in-store tablet sign-up and a design-consultation giveaway.
Uploaded and optimised 1,200 product pages, adding dimensions and fabric details that cut pre-sale enquiries to the call centre by a fifth.

achievements.title: Content programme
achievements.detail: Breed guide hub now ranks on page one for over 300 tracked search terms.

achievements.title: Retention gain
achievements.detail: First-renewal retention up six points after lifecycle journeys went live.
